annotation.title_clean: 中华人民共和国国务院令第764号 国务院关于修改和废止部分行政法规的决定
annotation.title_en: State Council Decree No. 764: Decision of the State Council on Amending and Repealing Certain Administrative Regulations
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 国务院 (State Council of the People's Republic of China)
annotation.summary_en: State Council Decree No. 764 (20 July 2023) amends 14 administrative regulations and repeals one, aligning them with the revised Administrative Penalty Law. It covers international shipping, scrap metal, road transport, invoices, certification and others. It has no AI or robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Amends 14 administrative regulations and repeals the Product Quality Supervision Trial Measures
Effective from the date of promulgation
Shifts some licensing to filing (备案) requirements in shipping and other sectors
Adjusts administrative penalties in road transport, Yangtze sand mining, and certification
Recognises electronic invoices as legally equivalent to paper invoices
